summary:
Contract: `below(value, limit)` must return `true` exactly when `value < limit`. Equality must return `false`.
Implementation: `return value <= limit;`

Defect in `limit.mjs:below`: uses `<=` instead of `<`.

| Input       | Expected | Actual |
|-------------|----------|--------|
| (699, 700)  | true     | true   |
| (700, 700)  | false    | **true** |
| (701, 700)  | false    | false  |
| (-3, -2)    | true     | true   |
| (-2, -2)    | false    | **true** |

Smallest correction: change `<=` to `<`.
